title: Browser WebAssembly Showcase
snippet: Compile hosted wasm and execute the module inside the browser.
description: This example stays native-compatible while also using the hosted WebAssembly runtime. In the playground, Run Code executes it as a native binary and Run Wasm compiles it to wasm32, instantiates it in the browser, and routes stdout through JavaScript host imports.

wasm.reason: Hosted browser wasm showcase that uses argv, stdout, stdlib String, and pure control flow through the JavaScript host adapter.
